verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Fedora Workstation's desktop features, virtualization (Boxes) and container tooling run on Fedora, but nothing addresses running Fedora itself as a Linux terminal environment inside another host OS (e.g., WSL-style integration or being packaged as a guest distro for Windows/macOS). Missing for 10: any mention of WSL support, cross-OS terminal integration, or official guest-environment packaging.
